notes: Three waws (s034, s036, s039) stand against three ASV connectives (*and*, *also*, *and*), so s036 takes the postposed *also* under rule 51 and nothing is added or unrepresented on that count.
*them all* after *destroyed* is added: עַד־לְכַלֵּה writes no object and no כֹּל, and rule 44 bars folding a supplied object into the verb.
עָרֵיהֶם → *into their own cities* gives the emphatic possessive *their own* whole to the suffix under rule 18, the construct keeping only *cities*.
